description: This file defines the CurlFactory class, which creates and manages cURL handles for HTTP requests using the Guzzle HTTP client library. It includes methods for creating cURL resources, configuring options, checking support for HTTP/2 and TLS versions, and handling request response lifecycle.

classes.name: CurlFactory
classes.description: A class responsible for creating, configuring, reusing, and releasing cURL handles for HTTP requests in the Guzzle HTTP client library.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates and configures a new EasyHandle for the given request and options.

methods.name: release
methods.description: Releases a cURL handle, either by adding it back to the cache or closing it if the cache limit is reached.

methods.name: finish
methods.description: Completes a cURL transaction, returning a fulfilled or rejected Promise based on success or error.

methods.name: supportsHttp2
methods.description: Checks if the current environment supports HTTP/2 via cURL.

methods.name: supportsTls12
methods.description: Checks if the current environment supports TLS 1.2 via cURL.

methods.name: supportsTls13
methods.description: Checks if the current environment supports TLS 1.3 via cURL.
